The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] maintained a '''camp''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Durik Vesh]] lost his mind and was captured, he was interrogated at the camp, and then moved to another outpost.
